Overview

Ithaca is a city in NY with a population of 32,000. Home of Cornell University and Ithaca College with gorges, waterfalls, and a progressive vibe. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The population skews young, with a median age of 23.6.
